blocks.html: The response body of the List Entity Columns API route.

types.name: columns
types.description: The list of available columns for the entity.

children.name: id
children.description: The column's unique identifier (e.g., "display\_id", "customer.email").

children.name: name
children.description: The display name for the column.

children.name: description
children.description: Description of the column.

children.name: field
children.description: The field path to access the data.

children.name: sortable
children.description: Whether the column can be sorted.

children.name: hideable
children.description: Whether the column can be hidden.

children.name: default_visible
children.description: Whether the column is visible by default.

children.name: data_type
children.description: The data type of the column.

children.name: semantic_type
children.description: The semantic type provides additional context about the data.

children.name: context
children.description: Additional context about the column.

children.name: computed
children.description: Information about computed columns.

children.name: metadata
children.description:
Arbitrary per-column configuration consumed by cell renderers (e.g. the
field path a renderer reads, or a value->variant map). Populated from the
settings entity override's `fieldMetadata` (any column) or a computed
column definition's `metadata`.

children.name: relationship
children.description: Information about relationship columns.

children.name: default_order
children.description: Default order for sorting columns.

children.name: category
children.description: Category for grouping columns.

children.name: render_mode
children.description: Render mode hint for the UI to determine how to display this column.

children.name: filter
children.description: Filter configuration for this column.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Whether filtering is enabled for this column.

children.name: operators
children.description: Available filter operators.

children.name: enumValues
children.description: Enum values if applicable.

children.name: relationship
children.description: Relationship filter config for dropdown selection.

children.name: source
children.description: Source information about where this column comes from.

children.name: module
children.description: Module name.

children.name: entity
children.description: Entity name.

children.name: custom_label
children.description: Whether this column uses a custom user-defined label.

children.name: label_id
children.description: ID of the PropertyLabel record if custom label is used.
